scope: Dynamic attribute grouping end-to-end: attribute_set_items.group_key drives labeled fieldset groups in the admin product-model edit and the attribute-set manager (add-item group input + per-item group display); the customer build flow renders each build component as a labeled group with its resolved attribute definitions. Dev-DB junk (legacy 7000-series categories/brands/models, Spec Test fixtures) removed so the admin catalog shows only the genuine 18-category seed.

businessFlow.subject: Attributes render in data-driven labeled groups instead of one flat list: the admin Desktop PC edit modal shows Processor/RAM/Storage/GPU/Power groups, the attribute-set manager shows each item's group and accepts a group on add, and the customer Desktop PC build flow shows each component (CPU/Motherboard/RAM/Storage/PSU/GPU) as its own group with its attribute definitions — then a complete build selection enables the review step.

notes: Grouping is assembled server-side (catalog service listAttributeSetDefinitions/listCategoryAttributeSetDefinitions + sell-taxonomy service enrichEntries) and consumed by both admin and web — no component name is hardcoded in the UI. RAM Capacity (GB) and Storage Capacity (GB) are visually separated by their component groups. Junk cleanup is a dev-DB-only data operation (not a migration) since no migration creates the legacy fixtures.
